description:
Several folios of astrological tables in Judaeo-Arabic. The hand resembles that of Avraham Ibn Yijū but is probably not his (the מ especially looks different). Some of the margins (and the entire verso of T-S K25.207) were reused for jotted accounts in Judaeo-Arabic in a rudimentary hand. 

T-S NS 322.88 + T-S Ar.29.153 are a direct join; the rest seem to be indirect joins. ENA 3577.7 and T-S Ar.29.165 have different dimensions and layout than the other fragments and may have come from a separate quire. The minute fragment belonging to this join under T-S AS 219.189 is the second from the right in the third row. A few of the joins were found via the Dicta Genizah Search website for the MiDRASH Automatic Transcriptions https://zenodo.org/records/17734473. Joins: Alan Elbaum.

Similar genre as T-S Ar.29.180 and Bodl. MS heb. d 74/32.
